query: Can a non-refundable hotel reservation be refunded?

candidates.text:
## Hotel Cancellation Rules
Travel insurance coverage is separate from the hotel's cancellation policy. A non-refundable reservation may still be reimbursed by an eligible insurance claim, while insurance does not automatically make the hotel reservation refundable.

Promotional or bonus points may have separate expiration and refund rules. ## Cash Refunds
Loyalty membership does not itself create a right to a cash refund for a non-refundable hotel reservation.

## Points Earned on Refunded Reservations
Loyalty points are generally awarded only for eligible completed travel. If a reservation is fully refunded, points awarded for that reservation may be removed. ## Partial Refunds
For a partially refunded reservation, points may be recalculated based on the final eligible booking amount. ## Bookings Paid With Points
When an eligible booking paid with points is cancelled, the return of points depends on reservation conditions and loyalty rules. A non-refundable hotel rate does not automatically become refundable because points were used. ## Promotional Points
Promotional or bonus points may have separate expiration and refund rules. ## Cash Refunds

# Hotel No-Show Policy

## Definition of a No-Show
A reservation is considered a no-show when the guest does not arrive on the scheduled check-in date and has not cancelled within the applicable cancellation period. ## Standard Reservations
The hotel may charge the first night's accommodation fee when the guest does not arrive and has not cancelled in time. Remaining nights may be released. ## Non-Refundable Reservations
For non-refundable reservations, the full reservation amount may remain non-refundable when the guest does not arrive. A no-show does not normally create an automatic right to a refund.

## Change Requests
Customers may request changes to check-in dates, check-out dates, guest information, and room type. Changes are subject to availability and the original reservation conditions. ## Price Differences
If the modified reservation is more expensive, the customer may need to pay the difference. A lower price does not automatically guarantee a refund of the difference. ## Non-Refundable Reservations
A non-refundable reservation may also be non-changeable. Some hotels may permit changes as an exception, but approval is not guaranteed. ## Cancellation vs Modification
Changing a reservation is different from cancelling it. Cancelling and creating a new booking may trigger the cancellation rules of the original reservation. ## Hotel Approval
